origin.description: Change the process working directory and return it.
origin.details: Change to /tmp, compare the real path, and change back. Both sides return 1.
origin.value: Change the process working directory and return it.
origin.example: { old <- getwd(); cd("/tmp"); ok <- as.numeric(normalizePath(pwd(), winslash="/") == normalizePath("/tmp", winslash="/")); setwd(old); ok }
